selection_policy: Select the AI candidate with the smallest factory-total MAE on March 10 00:00 through March 31 00:00 inclusive (505 hours). Mean/median are reference-only. Ties use fixed candidate order. April/May never select or replace the winner.

metric_definitions.factory_mae_kWh: Mean absolute error of hourly sums across all equipment, in physical kWh for the observed training-series aggregation
metric_definitions.normalized_mae: Hourly factory MAE divided by the mean actual hourly factory total; a ratio, not a percentage
metric_definitions.factory_bias_kWh: Mean(predicted factory kWh - actual factory kWh)
metric_definitions.module_mae_mean_kWh: Unweighted mean of equipment-specific hourly MAE values
metric_definitions.all: All hours in the evaluation month available in the source
metric_definitions.focus: Multiweek task-like evaluation window: March10-March31 00:00 or April10-April29 23:00, both inclusive
metric_definitions.mae_course_native: MAE for supplied reference columns hourly_pow, may_bill, may_carbon using the supplied numerical convention
metric_definitions.mae_kWh_if_reference_is_Wh: MAE of reference hourly_pow divided by1000; physical interpretation is conditional on the provider confirming hourly_pow is Wh
metric_definitions.may_normalized_mae: Course-native hourly_pow MAE divided by mean reference hourly_pow
metric_definitions.basic_error_target_passed: Normalized hourly factory MAE <=0.01; a proposed internal goal, not an official acceptance criterion

unit_contract.sensor_power_assumption: activePower is W, supported by the supplied course rules and accumulator increments
unit_contract.reference_cost_formula: course-native hourly_pow * 180; this is not a physical KRW bill under the W assumption
unit_contract.reference_carbon_formula: course-native hourly_pow * 0.424; this is not physical kgCO2 under the W assumption

evaluation_notice: April and May were inspected during earlier experiments. These results are retrospective reevaluations, not fresh unseen tests. This run freezes the AI choice using March factory MAE before evaluating April/May; no April/May-based reselection is allowed.
